build_duke_ultrasound_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for Duke ultrasound DAS beamformed phantom images and paired post-processed images
create_duke_ultrasound_dataset_info: create dataset info with FeaturesDict defining das, dtce, and metadata tensor schemas for the Duke ultrasound dataset
run_duke_ultrasound_split_generators: run split generators to download and extract phantom data, mark data, and CSV split files from Duke repository URLs
generate_duke_ultrasound_examples: generate examples by reading CSV rows, loading MATLAB files, and yielding das IQ data with dB, real, imag channels and dtce targets
review_duke_ultrasound_builder: review the Duke ultrasound Builder class with custom CSV split support and supervised keys mapping das/dB to dtce
